01 / THE GUILD

A familiar world.
A new chapter.

Welcome to Sleep Eat AFK.

We’re Sleep Eat AFK [SEA], an Alliance PvE guild in World of Warcraft: Forever, with members mainly from Singapore and Southeast Asia. This is our gathering point for the adventures ahead.

From the first login to the next “one more quest”, every journey needs a place to begin.

04 / PULL UP A CHAIR

Every adventure
starts with hello.

Interested in Sleep Eat AFK? Start a conversation before your next adventure.

Meet us on Discord ↗

  1. Enter the guild Discord

    Use our invitation and follow any server onboarding prompts.

  2. Introduce your character

    Share your character name, class, usual play times and what you enjoy in WoW.

  3. Ask about the next step

    Speak with the guild about current recruitment, activities and how to join in game. Discord access does not automatically grant guild membership.

05 / BEFORE YOU SET OUT

A few things
worth knowing.

What faction and focus is the guild?

Sleep Eat AFK is an Alliance PvE guild in World of Warcraft: Forever.

Where are most members based?

Our membership is mainly from Singapore and Southeast Asia. If you play from elsewhere, ask the guild about suitable play times.

What are the raid days and times?

A confirmed raid schedule is not published here. Ask in Discord for the latest plans before making commitments.

Is my class being recruited?

Current class and role needs are not listed here. Tell the guild what you play and ask about openings on Discord.

How do I apply or join?

Join our Discord, follow the server prompts and introduce yourself. The guild can explain its current joining process and expectations.

Where can I find the member dashboard?

When available, its link will appear in the connection section below. Discord is the available contact point in the meantime.
